name: The Last Room Remembers Everything
hint: Six takes, and the room uses every trick it ever taught you. p1 at x=4 LATCHES — cross it once and it stays on, powering lift m1 at x=24..28. The teleporter pad at x=8 emits you at x=18, which is how you skip walker w1 patrolling x=11..17. Up on the deck, p2 at x=32 reads recordings ONLY and shuts down both the laser at x=30 and the turret at the far right. Down on the floor, p3 at x=20 and p4 at x=22 together open the door at x=33.5. TAKE 1: walk across p1 — it latches, no standing required — then step into the pad at x=8 and look around the far side. TAKE 2: Echo A trips p1 at t=0.4s so the lift is already climbing. Teleport to x=18, run right and board m1 at about t=2.4s while its deck is low, ride from y=19 to y=12, cross the 1-unit gap onto the deck at x=29..39, and stand on p2 at x=32. Nothing lights up while YOU stand there; that is the point of it. TAKE 3: Echo B on p2 now kills the laser and the turret for good. Teleport, then stand on p3 at x=20. TAKE 4: teleport, stand on p4 at x=22 — the door at x=33.5 opens as soon as both are held, but you are pinned on the plate. TAKE 5: spend a take on insurance: teleport and stand in the turret lane at about x=28, where your recording will body-block anything the turret manages to fire before Echo B silences it. TAKE 6: the lift is armed, the beam is dead, the gun is dead, the door is open and the guard is chasing a recording. Teleport past it, run right along the floor, straight through the doorway at x=33.5, and walk into the exit at x=37. Every hazard in the last room of the game is being held shut by somebody who used to be you.

dialogue.text: Last room. Everything it knows how to do, it is doing at once.

dialogue.speaker: ECHO-0
dialogue.text: Five of us. That is all you get. It is enough if you spend us properly.
Walk out. Do not look back at the ones still standing there.
